usedFor: Webflow holds your site’s collections and forms, MailerLite holds subscribers, and “User Account Added” can feed “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “User Account Added” in Webflow, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A new user account on the site becomes a MailerLite subscriber, or updates the one that exists.

watchOut: “User Account Updated” and “Collection Item Changed” fire on edits, so “Create or Update Subscriber” can repeat for one record.
